VANTAGE_SITE_ID.description: Optional Nozomi Vantage site predicate forwarded verbatim as `site_id=<value>` on both GET /v1/sites and GET /v1/alerts. Empty / blank / missing walks the entire tenant's OT estate (the operator's API-key scope still applies). Vantage accepts both the numeric site id and the literal site name in this slot depending on tenant configuration; the executor forwards the operator's value verbatim and lets Vantage decide whether it matches. Useful for sharding inventory pulls across multiple discovery profiles so each dispatcher agent only walks one OT site (one plant / one facility) per run. Whitespace is trimmed.

name: nozomi_vantage
title: Nozomi Networks Vantage
description: Nozomi Networks Vantage OT / ICS site + alert importer. Pulls OT site inventory and security alerts from a Nozomi Vantage tenant via its v1 REST API and emits Faraday bulk-create JSON. Vantage is Nozomi's SaaS-delivered OT / IoT / IT visibility platform — it aggregates findings from federated Guardian appliances (and lightweight Vantage IQ collectors) across an operator's OT estate and surfaces both the resulting OT site catalog and the rule-based / anomaly alert feed via a hosted v1 REST surface. Endpoints used: GET /v1/sites?page=N&page_size=M (paginated OT site inventory; canonical envelope {'results': [...], 'count': N, 'next': '...', 'previous': '...'} — Vantage's Django-REST style — with federated mirrors also exposing bare lists or {'result': [...]} / {'data': [...]} / {'items': [...]} / {'sites': [...]}; each record carries id, name, description, location / address, city, country, latitude / longitude, time_zone, created_at / updated_at, the appliance roster (appliances / guardian_count), asset_count (rolled-up OT asset inventory size for the site), alert_count (open-alert backlog), and optional criticality / risk_score rollups (Critical / High / Medium / Low / Info label or 0..4 / 0..10 / 0..100 numeric on some tenants)) and GET /v1/alerts?site_id=<id>&page=N&page_size=M (same envelope shape; each record carries id, name / type_name, description, severity (Critical / High / Medium / Low / Info label or 0..10 numeric), type_id (Vantage inherits Guardian's published alert taxonomy: SIGN:NETWORK:MALWARE / SIGN:PROTOCOL:ANOMALY / VI:UNAUTHORIZED-COMMAND etc), status (open / acknowledged / closed / muted / resolved), record_created_at / record_updated_at (or created_at / updated_at on newer tenants), src_ip / dst_ip, risk (0..10), site_id / site_name, and zone_id / zone_name). Auth: Vantage uses the same stateless auth shape as Guardian — there is no login round-trip; the operator-issued VANTAGE_API_KEY is passed verbatim on every /v1/ request as Authorization: Bearer <key> (the documented Vantage API auth header; Vantage issues a single bearer-shaped key per tenant in the Vantage console rather than a username + password pair, so Guardian's Basic-Auth encoding does not apply, but the no-login-round-trip discipline matches). The key never leaves the dispatcher's process memory — it is only ever stitched into the outgoing Authorization header. VANTAGE_HOST is the tenant base URL (Vantage is multi-tenant SaaS so there is no global default — the executor exits cleanly when missing); whitespace is trimmed and https:// is added when the operator pasted in a bare FQDN. Pagination is one-based: page=1 is the first page, walks until len(records) < page_size or the env-only VANTAGE_PAGES knob is reached (default 10, clamped to [1, 100]). 401 short-circuits the whole executor (the API key is wrong); 403 / 429 / 5xx stop pagination on the affected surface and return what we have. VANTAGE_SITE_ID is forwarded verbatim as the site_id=<value> query parameter on both surfaces; blank / missing walks the full tenant. Each Vantage record becomes one Faraday host. Site records project the first usable IP in ip / primary_ip / ip_address onto host.ip (loopback / 0.0.0.0 / ::1 skipped, falling back to the 0.0.0.0 sentinel — Vantage sites are facility records and most do not carry an IP), name / label / site_name onto host.hostnames, and the location / address / city / region / country / time_zone chain joins onto host.os (a stand-in for the facility's physical placement); the site itself becomes one Faraday vulnerability with the [ASSET-INVENTORY] engine prefix so OT facility records land alongside the other CMDB-class feeds (Armis, Axonius, Device42, Fleet, runZero, Jamf Pro, Guardian). Alert records are keyed on the first usable src_ip / source_ip / dst_ip / destination_ip / ip / node_ip field (falling back to related_assets / related_devices lists, then 0.0.0.0 for policy-shaped alerts not keyed on any single asset); the alert title (name / type_name / title) lands on host.hostnames and the description / severity / type_id enrichment is embedded in the vulnerability description. Severity bucketing: sites use the rolled-up criticality field (Critical / High / Medium / Low / Info label or 0..4 numeric, falling back to risk_score / risk with 0..10 or 0..100 numeric ladders); alerts use severity directly (label or 0..10 numeric, falling back to risk / risk_score). Closed / Resolved / Muted / Suppressed / Dismissed / Acknowledged / Mitigated / Accepted-Risk alerts are floored to 'info' regardless of the published severity (preserved via an explicit Vantage-Status pivot). Unparseable / missing severity defaults to 'info'. Status is always 'open' so the operator's remediation workflow takes over; the closed state is preserved via the info-severity floor + the Vantage-Status pivot. Refs include explicit Vantage-SiteID / Vantage-AlertID / Vantage-SiteName / Vantage-Site / Vantage-Zone / Vantage-Location / Vantage-Address / Vantage-City / Vantage-Region / Vantage-Country / Vantage-TimeZone / Vantage-Latitude / Vantage-Longitude / Vantage-Criticality / Vantage-RiskScore / Vantage-AssetCount / Vantage-AlertCount / Vantage-GuardianCount / Vantage-Severity / Vantage-TypeID / Vantage-TypeName / Vantage-Category / Vantage-Status / Vantage-Risk / Vantage-SrcIP / Vantage-DstIP / Vantage-CreatedAt / Vantage-UpdatedAt pivots, plus the canonical NVD CVE permalink for any CVE ids surfaced in the cve_list / vulnerabilities / description / title / type_name fields. Tags: [nozomi_vantage, ot-security, site|alert].
